title: Trapping Rain Water

monster.name: Cataclysmic Abyssal Aquifer
monster.title: Leviathan of Inundated Ravines
monster.defeatQuote: You trapped all the volume across my elevation bars...

description: Given `n` non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
hints: Use two pointers moving inward. Maintain leftMax and rightMax; the water trapped at any position is bounded by min(leftMax, rightMax) - height.
